data.body:
An action declaration describes a change and its parameters, effects and requirements. Registration validates metadata; it does not grant authority or execute business effects.

The bundled SDK includes action metadata. Trusted consumer runtimes own transactions, authentication, retries, atomicity and replay. Executor capability comparison is separate from native execution qualification.

The existing Actions guide provides runnable examples and the reference consumer profile. Follow individual evidence records for exact PostgreSQL, source and subset qualifications. Historical certification does not establish current production adoption.

title: Actions: declaration and execution
